title: tares factory doctor --json: every check the crew needs, and what to fix

ok.description: False when any check is `fix`. The exit code is 1 then, and 0 otherwise; the document is printed either way.

id.description: Names the check (`claude`, `tares_access`, `project_<name>`). Stable: branch on it, never on `message`.

message.description: What the check found, in a sentence a person reads.

fix.description: What to run or change. Empty when there is nothing to do.
